claim_boundaries: Owned deterministic fault injection, not independent operational verification or an external vulnerability.
Pre-commit rollback restores exact logical rows; no assertion that SQLite physical file bytes are identical.
Post-commit exception preserves committed state; exact retry checks retained bytes.
Rollback refusal closes the handle under a functioning cleanup path; repeated interruption, OS termination and failed connection close remain outside this proof.
No native profile admission, external latest-head proof, power-fault/storage qualification, target execution or income.
